title: Insulin Pump Program Non-Covered Item Charge Computation Schedule
content:
**Schedule NC.** A non-covered item charge owed on an Insulin Pump Program is posted for the shipment the program's newest CO-151 claim denial bills, and is worked out as follows.

**NC-1 The denied line.** The denied line is the shipment the newest CO-151 denial's claim bills; its item, units, supply days and ship date are read from that shipment, its grant is the authorization grant it drew on, and its written order is the order that grant rests on. The newest CO-151 denial is the CO-151 claim denial of the program with the latest posting date.

**NC-2 Cash price per unit.** The cash price per unit is the Larkfield cash price of the line's item:

| Line item | Cash price per unit |
|---|---|
| A4225 cartridge | $6.85 |
| A4232 reservoir | $7.10 |
| A4224 infusion-set supply | $38.40 |
| A4239 sensor allowance | $395.00 |
| E0784 pump, Tandem t:slim X2 | $6295.00 |
| E0784 pump, Tandem Mobi | $4995.00 |
| E0784 pump, MiniMed 780G | $7350.00 |
| E0784 pump, Beta Bionics iLet | $5250.00 |

For an E0784 line the price is that of the pump model on the program.

**NC-3 Covered rate.** The standard covered rate for a denied line is the tier's reservoirs per 30 days.

**NC-4 Denied units.** The denied units are the line's units less the covered rate times the line's supply days divided by 30, never below zero.

**NC-5 Standard computation.** In the standard computation the denied line is Larkfield's write-off and nothing is charged.

**NC-6 Combination.** Any adjustment to the charge changes it as that adjustment states: replacements first, then the amounts taken off, never below zero, then the percentage reductions, which add together and are taken once from the charge; the charge is then rounded half up to the cent.

## Standard computation worked through (hypothetical A4225 line on a tier covering 10 cartridges per 30 days)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Units shipped; supply days | 45; 90 |
| Covered units: 10 multiplied by 90, divided by 30 | 30 |
| Denied units: 45 less 30 | 15 |
| Charge | $0.00 — Larkfield's write-off |
